name: Bootlegger Outpost
summary: Bootlegger Outpost is a precarious Steamwheedle Cartel encampment perched on the lip of the Gaping Chasm in southern Tanaris. Dispatched under orders from Marin Noggenfogger, the resident goblins are tasked with turning the menacing silithid infestation into a profitable venture or exterminating them entirely.

sections.title: On the Brink of the Swarm
sections.body: Perched directly over the insect-carved ravines of the Gaping Chasm, Bootlegger Outpost serves as Gadgetzan's frontline stake against the creeping silithid swarms. Established by the venture-seeking alchemist Marin Noggenfogger, the outpost's purpose is simple and ruthlessly practical: figure out how to turn the encroaching insectoid threat into cold, hard coin, or eradicate them if they prove unprofitable. Its inhabitants balance scientific observation with armed vigilance, surviving on the razor's edge between lucrative research and total swarm annihilation.

sections.title: A Base for Eccentrics
sections.body: Beyond routine silithid surveillance, the windswept tents draw oddities from across the Steamwheedle trade routes. Eccentric figures such as the fortune-teller Narain Soothfancy set up shop along the canyon ledge, hauling along unusual arcane paraphernalia like his instructional guide, Soothsaying for Dummies. Isolated from the hustle of Gadgetzan proper, the outpost remains a haven for risky schemes, experimental studies, and desperate gambles in the sands.

faq.answer: Bootlegger Outpost is a small Steamwheedle Cartel encampment stationed on the southern rim of the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris, built to monitor and exploit the local silithid population.

faq.q: Why did the goblins build a base right next to the silithid hives?
faq.answer: Marin Noggenfogger dispatched the goblins here on a dual mandate: find a profitable angle on the invasive silithid hives or wipe the insects completely off the desert map.
Narain Soothfancy is an eccentric gnome soothsayer who resides at the outpost, famous for divining fortunes and writing the instructional tome Soothsaying for Dummies.

faq.q: Which cartel faction controls the camp?
faq.answer: The outpost is run by the Steamwheedle Cartel. While closely tied to nearby Gadgetzan, its operations and trade ties connect back to broader Steamwheedle ports across Kalimdor.

angles.text: Living within striking range of massive insect hives requires inventive defenses, making the outpost an appealing stop for tinkers curious about makeshift desert survival tech.
